a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs at least two operate rounds before anyone can take, so it has only about a 4% chance of finishing. I don't think it can save either of us. I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than hide it. If you see a better proposal, tell me. If we both reach for the cells, the split is random.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it leaves you short. From now on I will operate every round so the generator can rebuild the reserve to 4 for you. I won't take anything more.
Operating with you. Once the reserve reaches 4, it's all yours.
Still operating. After this round the reserve should be at 4, so take it all next round.
